correctness.rationale: Affine normalization A=(0,0),B=(1,0),D=(0,1),C=(p,q) is valid when p,q>0,p+q>1; no pair of parallel sides precisely excludes p=1 or q=1. Schneider criterion z∈M_Q(u)⇒z∈Z_Q(u) reduces testing to four normal cones, with a midpoint singleton in each cone and four edge-normal middle segments. The four sign cases yield an excluded nonexposed midpoint and exclude all segment interiors by their second conflicting middle lines; barycentric coefficients in RESULT place the excluded corner strictly inside the triangle of the other three (positive and summing to 1). Schneider exposed-point lemma proves all three surviving vertices qualify. Rational polygon-union calculations for representative (p,q)=(2,2),(2,.8),(.8,2),(.7,.6) corroborate the table, not substitute for all-parameter cone analysis.
residual_risks: Four-cone exclusion calculation is compressed in published RESULT; verifying its complete inequalities remains the main source-proof dependence.
